column3: “a mercy seat” renders “kapporet,” the atonement cover (also in verses 7–9).
“toward each other” renders “each to its brother.”
“with which to pour out libations” renders “with which it was poured out.”
“flowers” renders “blossoms,” and “of one piece with it” renders “from it.”
NASB supplies “first,” “second,” and “third pair” where the Hebrew repeats “under two of the branches from it.”
